children: RNS Number : 2830V  Tungsten West PLC  18 September 2026

Tungsten West (AIM: TUN), the owner and operator of the Hemerdon tungsten and tin mine ("Hemerdon") in Devon, UK, is pleased to announce the appointment of Zeus Capital Limited (“Zeus”) as Joint Broker to the Company, alongside Hannam & Partners, with immediate effect.
Jeffery Court, Chief Executive Officer of Tungsten West, commented:

“We are pleased to welcome Zeus as Joint Broker to the Company. Zeus brings significant experience in the natural resources sector and strong relationships across the UK institutional investor base, and we look forward to working with the team as we ramp up operations at Hemerdon.”
James Spinney / James Dance / Abigail Wennington
Andrew Chubb / Matt Hasson / Jay Ashfield
